# Town of Georgia municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Georgia, official election results page, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026: Carolyn Branagan was elected Moderator, 707 votes.

Town of Georgia, official election results page, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026: Cheryl Letourneau was elected Town Clerk, 712 votes, for a term ending March 2029. The results page misspells the surname 'Letorunaeu'; the form here is the town clerk block's own spelling.
Town of Georgia, official election results page, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026: Kevin Webster was elected First Constable, 697 votes.
Town of Georgia, official election results page, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026: Jamie Cota was elected Second Constable, 695 votes.

Town of Georgia, official election results page, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026: the March 3, 2026 vote elected three trustees to one-year seats, among them Sarah Savich (392) and Brian Dunsmore (432).

Georgia Public Library, Staff & Trustees page (live): the sitting trustees include Brian Dunsmore (Chair), Sarah Savich (Vice Chair), and Kollene Caspers (Secretary, a continuing trustee). Dunsmore and Savich are resolved by both sources and Caspers by the roster; the third elected trustee, Ben Chiappinelli (555), does not appear on the current roster, and two roster trustees (Julia Harvey, Deborah Mann) have no published seating mechanism -- all three are held as a decision item on issue #163 and are not minted here.
